avis.titre: Effective, strong, and suitable for blemish-prone combination skin
avis.texte: I have sensitive combination skin that is prone to hormonal and diet-related blemishes now and then. These Ji Woo Gae blemish toner pads work well with my skin type - though those who have dry skin might find them a bit too strong. I would mostly recommend this for those with blemish-prone oily or combination skin. If you have sensitive skin like me, I would also use it on alternate days until you can be sure it is not causing a reaction since everyone’s skin may react differently (personally, I did not have an averse reaction, so I switched to daily use once I felt safe). I like a lot of the ingredients and found the toner highly effective when used once a day. I’ve been using it at night after makeup removal and cleansing, with good results. The pads are big and soaked with a lot of toner - more than enough for a single use. As such, I wish the pads were just slightly smaller and there were more pads in the jar instead, as I feel that there is so much toner leftover after each use that goes to waste. However, even with the current proportions allocated, the jar should last around 2 months if used once a day, so the toner pads are still worth it. The jar containing the pads is well designed, made of higher grade plastic (especially the frosted portion), and looks good sitting on a shelf. I liked the packaging of this, and found that it contributed to the enjoyment of using the product. For what it’s worth, I followed the toner with my usual routine of serum, eye cream, moist

I really feel so clean after using these toner pads. They have a lot of product in them but the good thing is they are not sopping wet. I've dealt with overly wet pads, and they are just too messy to deal with. These are saturated but just enough to give you a refreshing sensation of cleaning all over the face several times and the neck. They feel so good. Also, they are large pads, so they provide great coverage. One is all I needed per each use. The smell is not too bad although yes, it's strong when using. It smells typical of toners and astringents. The medicinal odor does not linger. Once absorbed into the skin the smell fades. Leaves my face clean and supple. It' does help to eliminate some of my blemishes. Does not dry my skin out nor did it irritate it either. I've used these for a month with no issues.

avis.titre: So easy to use, and leaves your face feeling refreshed.
avis.texte: These toning pads are the perfect addition to my skin care routine. I have recently started incorporating a toner, I have noticed a significant improvement in my skin. It looks brighter and more refreshed. I use a toner pad all over my face, right after washing it first. From there, I use a facial Vitamin E serum, and as a last step, moisturizer. If you haven’t started incorporating a toner into your skin care routine, this is a great product to start with. It is reasonably priced, and having the individual pads ready for you to use a great benefit.

avis.titre: Good quality toner; convenient form (soaked cotton pads)
avis.texte: These toner pads are good for acne-prone and oily skin, as they help reduce and control excessive sebum. This solution comes in a convenient form — soaked cotton pads — which makes applying quick and easy. The pads have a quilted texture which adds to the exfoliating factor of this toner, and are overall soft and gentle against your skin. They are thin but large enough that one pad is more than enough for your entire face and neck. I don’t mind the scent of these, but I’m not a fan of how they leave my skin shiny and a bit tacky. Other than that, the solution feels lightweight and isn’t too noticeable, and it has undeniable benefits. For how many come in a container, the affordable price makes it a great value for money. They would make a good gift to just about anyone and I would recommend.

The scent of the pads are okay I like that they are really wet and refreshing. They did leave my face clean and bright after using. The container it came in is pretty nice too. I actually like trying these.

First of all the packaging is so chic looking. I love that it’s frosted and see through instead of what every other company does with the white plastic twist off container. This even has a nice pop up top for easier access to the pads. This smells really nice, kinda like lemon lime not a chemical smell. They’re very soft and do not leave a sticky after feeling. I’m super happy with these! I have very sensitive skin and my face didn’t get angry after use.

So impressed with these toner pads, they contain salicylic acid which is perfect to get rid of blemishes, It brings a lot so it should last you for about 2 months max if you use it everyday, the packaging is super good quality and so are the pads, they are also super big. Loved it for the price, definitely worth it.

Quality toner pads. You can tell by the scent (salicylic acid) that these are going to work well at controlling blemishes. These were very saturated with product. The disc were big enough that they were very easy to hold and maneuver over the face/skin. 10/10 recommend.

These pads are very moisturizing and help with calming skin! I’m in the middle of an acne breakout now and it’s been amazing in helping me rejuvenate my skin in the mornings. One pad holds a lot of moisture and can be used for the whole face. It also sticks to your face so I just rotate it around my face for a couple minutes for my skin to fully soak in product. I can’t highly recommend this enough!

High quality packaging and very good ingredient list. I use one pad at night after washing my face. I have acne prone skin and I saw the results even after the first use. They have some scent but it does not bother me. My skin is somewhat sensitive and I don’t have any irritation or tingling after using them. Also each pad is well absorbed in the solution, so it is enough for the whole face plus neck.
Me encantan estos toner pad muy cómodos y convenientes si tienes poco tiempo para hacer tú skincare, muy refrescantes y absorbe rápido la piel, me encanta los resultados
